title: Flui Application Manifest (v1beta1)
description: Deploy a source-code repository (built from its Dockerfile via CI) to a Flui cluster. This is a deliberately broad forward contract: fields tagged "x-flui-status": "planned" are part of the spec but not yet applied on source deploys — validators accept them and surface a warning (not an error). Untagged fields are implemented. As a planned field ships, its tag flips to "implemented" and the warning disappears.

apiVersion.description: Canonical: flui.cloud/v1beta1. flui/v1 is accepted as a legacy alias.

name.description: Stable slug used as the app identifier. Lowercase DNS label: starts with a letter, no leading/trailing dash, max 63 chars.

strategy.description: `dockerfile` builds the repo Dockerfile. `auto` lets railpack detect the framework.

dockerfile.description: Path to the Dockerfile, relative to the repo root. Monorepo: point at the subdir, e.g. `api/Dockerfile`.

context.description: Docker build context, relative to the repo root. Monorepo: e.g. `api`.

port.description: The port your app listens on inside the container. MUST match what your code binds (commonly process.env.PORT).

exposure.description: `public` = Ingress + TLS + DNS on a public hostname. `internal` = ClusterIP only, reachable via the dashboard proxy.

path.description: HTTP path probed for readiness/liveness. MUST be a real route that returns 2xx — a wrong path (e.g. /health when the route is /api/health) makes every probe fail silently.

profile.x-flui-note: Not yet applied on source deploys — set resources.requests/limits explicitly. A profile→requests/limits mapping is the first planned field to land.
profile.description: T-shirt size mapped to CPU/memory requests+limits.

scaling.x-flui-note: Not yet applied on source deploys — the manifest scaling block does not configure autoscaling yet. The app runs at a single replica.

fqdn.description: Explicit FQDN to expose on (apex, or a subdomain on another zone). Bypasses the cluster's assigned zone; taken verbatim.

hostnameMode.description: `ip` = nip.io hostname against the master IP. `domain` = real DNS zone (needs a configured ClusterDnsZone).

certChallenge.description: ACME challenge. `dns-01` needs a DNS zone and supports wildcards.

certificateProvider.description: Use lets-encrypt-staging for testing without hitting rate limits.

name.description: RUNTIME env var injected at container start. NOTE: build-time vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_*, VITE_*, PUBLIC_*) are baked at image build and are NOT set from here — declare them as Docker build args in your Dockerfile.

secret.x-flui-note: Not yet applied on source deploys — the value is currently injected as a plain env entry regardless.
secret.description: Store the resolved value in the app Secret (encrypted), injected via secretKeyRef.

valueFrom.x-flui-note: Not yet applied on source deploys — only env vars with a literal `value` are injected today. A valueFrom env is currently dropped.

userEditable.x-flui-note: Not yet applied on source deploys.
